The system is \(3x - y - 2z = 2\), \(2y - z = -1\), \(3x - 5y = 3\), with \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & 0 \end{bmatrix}\), \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ -1 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}\).
\(|A| = 3(2 \cdot 0 - (-1)(-5)) - (-1)(0 \cdot 0 - (-1) \cdot 3) + (-2)(0 \cdot (-5) - 2 \cdot 3)\)
\(= 3(-5) + 1(3) - 2(-6) = -15 + 3 + 12 = 0\).
Since \(|A| = 0\), compute \((\operatorname{adj} A) B\). The cofactor matrix is \(\begin{bmatrix} -5 & -3 & -6 \\ 10 & 6 & 12 \\ 5 & 3 & 6 \end{bmatrix}\), so \(\operatorname{adj} A = \begin{bmatrix} -5 & 10 & 5 \\ -3 & 6 & 3 \\ -6 & 12 & 6 \end{bmatrix}\).
\((\operatorname{adj} A) B = \begin{bmatrix} -5 & 10 & 5 \\ -3 & 6 & 3 \\ -6 & 12 & 6 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ -1 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -10 - 10 + 15 \\ -6 - 6 + 9 \\ -12 - 12 + 18 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -5 \\ -3 \\ -6 \end{bmatrix} \neq O\).
Since \(|A| = 0\) and \((\operatorname{adj} A) B \neq O\), the system is inconsistent.

Let \(P(x, y)\) be any point on AB. Then, area of triangle ABP is zero (Why?). So
\[\frac{1}{2}\begin{vmatrix} 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 \\ x & y & 1 \end{vmatrix} = 0\]
This gives \(\frac{1}{2}(y - 3x) = 0\) or \(y = 3x\), which is the equation of required line AB.
Also, since the area of the triangle ABD is 3 sq. units, we have
\[\frac{1}{2}\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ k & 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \pm 3\]
This gives, \(\frac{3k}{2} = \pm 3\), i.e., \(k = \pm 2\).
note: The determinant is 3k (expanding along the second row), not -3k; the values k = +2 or -2 are unchanged.
